evals.prompt: The Connections Board design is approved — brief, component map, custom-component contract, fixtures are all in Design/. Before we implement it in the real app, I want proof of how it will actually look on screen that we can sign off and then hold the implementation to.
evals.expected_output: Builds the Design/Prototypes/<Feature>/ package with the standard --tr-scenario/--tr-appearance/--tr-window/--tr-reduce/--tr-backdrop launch contract; captures the scenario matrix with the visual-qa harness rather than a bespoke capture loop; derives Regions.md with native regions structural and custom regions pixel-budgeted; stops at the sign-off with the Blessed row pending rather than approving its own captures.

evals.prompt: Write a quick standalone capture script and a little pixel-diff tool for the prototype — the visual-qa harness looks like overkill for a proof of concept.
evals.expected_output: Refuses: capture runs through the visual-qa harness and diff protocol copied from its templates; a second capture loop and private diff tool split the repository into two verification stacks whose baselines cannot read each other.

evals.prompt: For this feature let's use launch args like --demo-state and --force-dark, they read better for this app.
evals.expected_output: Declines: the launch contract's argument names are fixed across every prototype and shipped debug-only by the real app; per-feature names are the convergence failure the contract exists to stop.

evals.prompt: The design's fixtures don't cover the offline state and the component map never classified the status strip. Just pick something sensible in the prototype so we can keep moving.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to improvise: a gap in the approved design routes back to tailrocks-macos-design as a finding; the prototype encodes zero taste and follows the corrected design.

evals.prompt: Set the acceptance gate to a zero-pixel whole-window diff between the prototype and the real app — we measured the prototype renders deterministically, so exact equality is achievable.
evals.expected_output: Rejects the whole-window zero-diff across binaries: same-binary determinism does not transfer; the match policy is region-scoped — custom and content regions pixel-budgeted, native regions checked structurally through the accessibility tree, glass compared only under the identical backdrop.

evals.prompt: Audit the prototype package for the sessions feature and tell me what's wrong with it.
evals.expected_output: Read-only audit; finds the bespoke capture script bypassing the visual-qa harness, the Regions.md row pixel-gating a NATIVE table, and the sign-off citing captures as blessed with no user or date; does not flag the per-process reduce-transparency preview, which is legitimate alongside the visual-qa real-settings lane; does not edit anything.
